name: Teeth whitening (non-dental studio)

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: a non-dental studio whitens teeth as a cosmetic service; it never cleans, fills, diagnoses or treats teeth. Where a state's dental rules limit whitening outside a dental office, the owner must not book it (the owner's own decision; Rosie checks nothing)
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration it chooses to show; each tech's training is their own word
pf.license.ask: optional: a registration number or a training certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each tech
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate or insurance for this work
pf.license.certificates: a whitening training certificate is shown as the tech's own word, never as a dental license
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.renewals: none checked; a date on a certificate is only a reminder the business sets itself
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
pf.license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.claims: no dental or medical claims: whitening is cosmetic; it doesn't treat decay, gum disease or any tooth problem

pf.services.shape: one whitening session per visit, with a tech the client picks or any free one; a shade check; packages of sessions; a home or venue visit for a party
pf.services.examples: the example businesses' own prices (Lee Smile Studio and Lee Mobile Smile), not a standard

list.length: 60 min, plus 10 min to clean the chair
list.before: a card saved for the $100 fee

list.before: paid in full when booked, on the secure page or at the desk

list.name: Touch-up at home, 30 min, paid in full

pf.services.travel: a home visit is included in the price inside the 25-mile area (the example's setting); a travel fee for farther towns where Sam sets one
pf.services.capacity: one tech per session; a party is one booking with several people, each with their own form
pf.services.skills: in-studio and at-home whitening with a gel and a light; touch-ups; shade checks; no cleaning, polishing, fillings, extractions or diagnosis
pf.services.online: no: whitening is done in person (a shade check can be by video only if Sam turns it on)
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the client must be there

beforeTimes: the service wanted (in-studio, a touch-up, a package, or a party) and the shade wanted
a tech by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
at home or at a venue: the town, the place, and how many people
for a party: the date and the time of the event
afterTime: any crowns, veneers, bonding or fillings in the front teeth (the tech decides what can whiten)
how sensitive the teeth are, and any tooth that hurts now
securePage: 18 or older (no whitening is booked for anyone under 18)
the dental and health form: dental work, gum disease, sensitive teeth, pregnancy or nursing, medicines, allergies to peroxide or gels, and when a dentist last saw them
a party: each person's own form
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult, for themselves or another adult; nobody under 18 (the example's setting)

stop.words: tooth pain, a swollen face or gums, pus, a broken or loose tooth, or bleeding gums
stop.say: Please see a dentist first. Teeth whitening waits until a dentist says it's OK.
stop.booking: no booking until a dentist says it's OK

stop.words: trouble breathing, chest pain, or fainting
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. The visit can wait.

refuse.words: a request to whiten a tooth that isn't the client's own, or any sexual request
refuse.say: This studio offers teeth whitening only. This request can't be booked.
refuse.what: the exact words go to the business's safety log; Sam picks: refuse and block that chat or number, or it was innocent and a session may be booked (every later message is checked again); no reply in 2 of Sam's text hours: nothing is booked

goOn.words: a cold sore or a sensitive tooth
goOn.what: the tech may skip a tooth or use a lighter gel; the visit goes on
the visit moves with no fee

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Dental and health form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms by the day before
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until dental work or health changes
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (gum disease, a tooth that hurts, dental work, pregnancy or nursing, a peroxide allergy) goes to the tech to read before the booking is kept

steps.name: Tech's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the tech's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a lighter gel, a tooth skipped); a dentist's OK first; or no, with the reason kept private

pf.first_steps.prep: brush and floss before the visit; no whitening strips or gel on the day; tell the studio on the secure page about any change in teeth or gums; at home: a clean chair and a sink nearby

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at home or a venue: the code at the door, from the client who booked
pf.visit.beforeWork: the tech checks the form, the shade and any tooth that hurts with the client before the gel goes on; the tech stops at any pain, swelling or a crack
pf.visit.changes: a touch-up or a second session is priced and OK'd before it's done
pf.visit.stop: the tech stops the visit at any pain, swelling or a crack; Sam decides any charge (only what the client agreed to) and any block; it goes in the safety log
pf.visit.away: only techs Sam allows go to homes or venues; the tech's DONE is the check-out: no DONE 15 minutes after the booked end, Rosie texts, then calls the tech, then tells Sam with the address
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the tech; the tech's notes (shade before and after, any sensitivity) go in the client's private record

pf.money.before: at the studio: a card saved for the $100 late-cancel and no-show fee; a 3-session package paid in full when bought; at home: a card saved for the $150 fee, or a touch-up paid in full; a party's $300 deposit when booked, and the rest billed after
pf.money.caps: deposit and fee caps: the business's own; a deposit is never more than the price, and a fee is never more than what was paid now
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before at the studio, and until 7am the day of a visit at home or a venue (the owner's settings)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $100 at the studio; $150 at home; a party keeps its $300 deposit; Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed or paid now
pf.money.conduct: a visit ended for the client's conduct: charged only what the booking page said, and only if Sam says so
pf.money.packs: packages and gift cards: sold at the studio, or on the secure page where Sam turns it on; a visit uses one session
pf.money.tips: off: no tip line on whitening bills
pf.money.tax: a tax line where the state's rules tax the service or the product
pf.money.insurance: none: the studio bills no health plan or dental insurance

pf.messages.never: dental answers, health answers, pregnancy, medicines and the tech's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
pf.messages.tone: no words that promise a dental result, a treatment or a cure; whitening is cosmetic, and the studio is not a dental office
pf.messages.minors: nobody under 18 is booked; Rosie never texts a minor

pf.staff.licenses: no dental license for cosmetic whitening in the business's own design; a training certificate is each tech's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: in-studio and at-home whitening with a gel and a light; touch-ups; shade checks; no cleaning, polishing, fillings, extractions or diagnosis
pf.staff.gender: each tech's gender is set only so a client can ask for a woman or a man; a filter used only when the client asks
pf.staff.supervision: a trainee works only with a named tech in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs same-day sessions and new clients at the studio; he can set every home or venue visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked tech, then to Sam after 1 hour
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in must fit the shade and the session booked, and gets the dental form and notes
pf.staff.away: only techs Sam allows are offered for homes and venues

pf.rules.showLicense: no license claim on listings, times or confirmations; the business's own registration shows only if it has one
pf.rules.draping: not applicable: the client sits in a chair with eye protection and a bib; a request to skip the protection is refused
pf.rules.hours: no sessions in hours the business has not set (the example's own hours)
pf.rules.away: home and venue visits only inside the 25-mile area, and only where Sam allows the tech
pf.rules.minors: 18 or older only, with no exception
pf.rules.reset: 10 minutes between clients to clean the chair (the example studio's setting)
pf.rules.records: dental forms and notes kept 7 years

pf.edges.improper: a request for sexual services: refused, logged and sent to Sam (pf.safety)
pf.edges.lateArrival: the session starts when the client arrives, at full price; at the studio, no word 15 minutes after the start is a no-show
pf.edges.runsLate: the tech runs late: the client keeps the full time if the next booking and the 10-minute clean still fit; if not, a new time with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: a stand-in who fits the shade and the session booked, with the form and notes; or new times with no fee
pf.edges.healthChange: a new tooth pain, swelling or change before the session: the client updates the form; the tech decides; a move has no fee
pf.edges.conduct: a visit ended for the client's conduct: Sam decides any charge (only what was agreed) and any block
pf.edges.awaySafety: the safety check-out after visits at a home or a venue
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
